incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] service=decode-streamer env=prod region=us-west-2 severity=high error_rate=13% pods_crashed=3 note=CUDA_OOM suspected. paging oncall @Maya :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): ack
Maya (oncall): looking at logs now. what's the customer impact?
Ben SRE: seeing repeated 'CUDA error: out of memory' in decode logs + kernel oom-kill for grpc-server container on node gpu-12. stack traces show large KV cache growth during streaming decode.
Maya (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) throttle streaming concurrency to 4 2) route heavy streaming routes to fallback small model 3) cordon + restart the offending node. anyone oncall for router changes?
deploy-bot: /rollout-config service=router concurrency_limit=4 requested by Maya (oncall)
Ben SRE: throttle applied to router (concurrency_limit=4). monitoring metrics.
Raj - CS: AcmeCorp reported 502s ~16:09 UTC, they have a nightly job. I told them we're triaging and will follow up.
Maya (oncall): @Alice can you patch per-route max_tokens to 1024? we suspect a misconfigured route had default_max_tokens=32768 and caused runaway generation.
Alice (eng-runtime): applying hotfix now. editing /configs/prod/router.yaml -> set default_max_tokens: 1024 for routes: streaming.longform, generator.experimental
Alice (eng-runtime): config pushed, hash b7f4. starting canary rollout.
deploy-bot: config-rollout started: router config b7f4 (canary 5% -> 25%)
Maya (oncall): also enable fallback model redwood-small-quant for those routes during the rollout.
Ben SRE: switching traffic for streaming.longform -> redwood-small-quant (gradual).
Alice (eng-runtime): tailing decode_streamer logs:
```
[decoder.cpp:442] decode_loop: token_idx=2213 allocated=81234567 bytes
[2025-11-02T16:11:03Z] decode_streamer[pid=8921]: CUDA error: out of memory while allocating 78MB (cuMemAlloc)
[2025-11-02T16:11:04Z] kernel: Killed process 8921 (grpc-server) total-vm:12G, anon-rss:11G
```
Alice (eng-runtime): clear sign of runaway gen + kv-cache growth eating GPU vram.
Maya (oncall): cordoning node gpu-12 and draining pods (moving to gpu-15/gpu-16).
SRE infra bot: node gpu-12 cordoned by Maya (oncall)
Ben SRE: drained and restarted workloads on gpu-15/gpu-16. new pods reporting healthy and GPU memory usage back to baseline (~40-50%).
Maya (oncall): error rate trending down. 502s from 13% -> 2% over 6m. continuing to monitor.
Raj - CS: update sent to AcmeCorp: "We've applied throttles and a fallback model; you may have seen some dropped requests. We're monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem."
Maya (oncall): handing off to Ben SRE for follow-up and postmortem. handoff time 16:40 UTC. Ben please own next steps.
Ben SRE: ack. taking over. immediate follow-up: add hard per-route cap (env MAX_ROUTE_TOKENS=1024), add alert for sustained GPU mem pressure >85% for >2m, and emit k8s pod_oom_count -> PagerDuty.
Alice (eng-runtime): I'll add a runtime reject in the gateway to refuse requests with absurdly large token requests and huge prompt sizes (reject if request_tokens + max_tokens > 16000). patching gateway now.
Maya (oncall): closing paging notification. status: mitigated -> monitoring. leaving notes in incident doc INC-2025-5432.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-5432 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.
Ben SRE: postmortem assigned to Ben SRE + Alice (eng-runtime). draft due in 48h. action items captured: [1] per-route hard caps, [2] runtime reject threshold, [3] add GPU mem pressure alert, [4] increase observability on KV-cache size and long-running decode spans.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. thumbs up. :thumbsup:
